verdict.rationale: Elastic documents a first-party one-liner (start-local) that spins up Elasticsearch and Kibana in Docker "for local development or testing", with a trial license covering all features. That gives users a separate test instance apart from production. It is a local dev install, though, not a dedicated sandbox mode, and nothing documents isolation from or seeding with production data. Missing for 10: a dedicated or hosted sandbox environment feature, documented isolation guarantees from production data, a way to clone or seed test data safely, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Quickly set up Elasticsearch and Kibana in Docker for local development or testing, using this one-liner in the command line.
This setup comes with a one-month trial license that includes all Elasticsearch features.
If you are a new user, sign up for a free 14-day trial to create a serverless project.
